mapper.sql: select ID, MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, CLASS_SHIFT, OPEN_MACHINE_CLASS, STATUS, REMARK, IS_DELETE, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME from T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO
mapper.select:
IS_DELETE ='0' and INSTR(MACHINE_CODE, #{machineCode}) > 0 and MACHINE_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{machineName}), '%') and STATUS = #{status}
order by CREATE_TIME desc

select.if: select a.MACHINE_ID as ID,b.MACHINE_CODE,b.MACHINE_NAME from T_TQ_SPECIFY_MACHINE a inner JOIN T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO b on a.MACHINE_ID=b.ID and b.STATUS = '0' where a.IS_DELETE='0' and a.JOB_TYPE='0' and a.MATERIAL_CODE=#{machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select a.MACHINE_ID as ID,b.MACHINE_CODE,b.MACHINE_NAME from T_TQ_MOUTH_PLATE a inner JOIN T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO b on a.MACHINE_ID=b.ID and b.STATUS = '0' where a.IS_DELETE='0' and a.STATUS='0' and a.MOUTH_PLATE_CODE=#{machineName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.MACHINE_ID not in ( select MACHINE_ID from T_TQ_SPECIFY_MACHINE where IS_DELETE='0' and JOB_TYPE='0' and MATERIAL_CODE=#{machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

select a.ID,a.MACHINE_CODE,a.MACHINE_NAME from T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO a where a.IS_DELETE='0' and a.STATUS='0' and a.ID not in ( select MACHINE_ID from T_TQ_SPECIFY_MACHINE where IS_DELETE='0' and JOB_TYPE='0' and MATERIAL_CODE=#{machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} union select MACHINE_ID from T_TQ_MOUTH_PLATE where IS_DELETE='0' and STATUS='0' and MOUTH_PLATE_CODE=#{machineName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO ( MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, CLASS_SHIFT, OPEN_MACHINE_CLASS, STATUS, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, REMARK, IS_DELETE ) VALUES
( #{MACHINE.machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{MACHINE.machineName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{MACHINE.classShift,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{MACHINE.openMachineClass,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{MACHINE.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{MACHINE.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{MACHINE.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '0' )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE MACHINE_NAME = VALUES(MACHINE_NAME), CLASS_SHIFT = VALUES(CLASS_SHIFT), OPEN_MACHINE_CLASS = VALUES(OPEN_MACHINE_CLASS), STATUS = VALUES(STATUS), UPDATE_BY = VALUES(CREATE_BY), UPDATE_TIME = NOW(), REMARK = VALUES(REMARK)
